description: Defines classes and functions for managing Ethernet frame buffers and pools, including lock-free buffer management, reservation, enqueueing, and expiry handling within a 5G/NR radio context.

classes.name: frame_buffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer for Ethernet frames with state management and timestamping.

classes.name: frame_buffer_pool
classes.description: Manages lock-free pool of frame_buffer objects, handling reservation, state transitions, and expiry.

classes.name: scoped_frame_buffer
classes.description: Wrapper for managing lifetime and access to a frame_buffer within the pool.

classes.name: eth_frame_pool
classes.description: Pre-allocated pool of Ethernet frame buffers for specific slots and symbols, supporting reservation and batch operations.

classes.name: frame_pool_interval
classes.description: Defines a start and end interval of slot symbols for batch access to eth_frame_pool.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves a free frame buffer for a specific slot and symbol, returning a scoped handle.

methods.name: enqueue_pending
methods.description: Enqueues all pending buffers into a burst vector for transmission.

methods.name: pop_pending
methods.description: Pops all pending buffers for expiry check and re-queues or frees them.

methods.name: return_to_pending
methods.description: Returns a buffer to the pending state after expiry check.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Transitions buffer state based on current state and expiry conditions.

methods.name: put_to_pending_queue
methods.description: Adds a reserved buffer to the pending queue.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees a buffer and updates its state.

methods.name: get_pool_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the pool entry for a given slot and symbol.
